description: This Java class named Content represents a content entity within the sales management system. It includes fields for identifiers, descriptions, merchant store association, visibility, content positioning, content type, and sorting order, along with associated getters and setters. It is mapped as a JPA entity for database persistence with annotations specifying schema, table, and constraints.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class modeling content data with associations to descriptions and merchant store, including visibility, positioning, and type attributes, mapped to the CONTENT database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the content entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the content entity.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section containing audit-related metadata.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Assigns the audit section to the content.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the content.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of the content.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the content.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the content is marked as visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets the list of descriptions related to the content.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the content.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type (grouping such as BOX, SECTION, PAGE).

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Assigns a content type to the content.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary description if available.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order for displaying content.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the content.

methods.name: getContentPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the content within a group.

methods.name: setContentPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the content within a group.
